prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1282; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of acute low back pain and muscle tightness radiating into the left paraspinal region. Initial evaluation documented restricted lumbar range of motion and localized tenderness without neurological deficit. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a soft tissue injury consistent with lumbar strain. Causation has not yet been firmly established, as the timing and mechanism of onset are still being reviewed against the patient's reported history. No prior injury to the lumbar region is known from the records available to this office. Care was delivered over twelve visits consisting of manual therapy, guided stretching, and a home exercise program. Treatment followed a typical clinical course, with pain scores and mobility improving steadily and visit frequency tapering as the patient recovered. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no repeated charges. Patient is currently discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
